Greetings visitors! Welcome to my personal website. This site will serve as a platform to showcase my work, share my experiences, and provide information about myself. I hope that you find the content here informative and engaging. Please feel free to explore the different sections of the site, and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or would like to connect.

As a start, I would like to introduce myself. My name is Rifqi Muhammad Harrys. I have a bachelor's degree in Geodesy and Geomatics Engineering from Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB) or Bandung Intsitute of Technology, Indonesia. I currently work as an Expert Mapping Surveyor at Badan Informasi Geospasial (Geospatial Information Agency) in Indonesia, where I specialise in marine and coastal mapping.

I am quite passionate about geospatial data and its applications in various fields, especially in the field of marine and coastal mapping and remote sensing technologies. I am also interested in the development of geospatial data infrastructure and its role in supporting national development. In addition to my work, I am also actively involved in research and development activities related to geospatial data and its applications.
